claims.statement: The UI annotation describes Explorer files in the sidebar by default, reorderable views in the Activity Bar, editor file tabs, panels for output/debug/terminal and a status bar with branch/port information. UI display is not proof of repository custody, effective configuration, permissions or protection; no UI changed.
Codespaces creation channels include the hosted site, editor and CLI. Channel availability does not prove account eligibility, safe source setup or authority to create a billable instance.

The payer fragment lists organization budget absent or nonzero, origin in an organization repository or organization-owned fork, and creator membership/collaboration plus organization enablement. It preserves GHEC public/private/internal versus FPT public/private branches rather than treating internal visibility as universal. Non-enabled users may still create from public organization repositories at personal expense. These contextual conditions are not proof of current billing or unconditional success: quota, policy and managed-user exceptions remain relevant. No budget, user enablement or payer changed; surrounding page context and conditional rendering remain separate.

Creation from organization repositories depends on visibility and organization/parent-enterprise settings among other factors. A readable repository or documented creation channel is not sufficient proof of entitlement. The linked no-access troubleshooting section remains separate, and no live eligibility was tested.
